passages.scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme
passages.text: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS) is implemented by Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India. It is a non-contributory pension scheme to provide social security to widows of poor family (BPL) of the society.

passages.scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme
passages.text: A pension of Rs.300/- per month is provided to Widows between 40 years and 79 years.

source.locator: department.txt / myScheme page (identical text); Benefits, age 40-79

passages.scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme
passages.text: For persons who are 80 years and above the pension is Rs.500/- per month.

source.locator: department.txt / myScheme page (identical text); Benefits, age 80 and above

passages.scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme
passages.text: The applicant must be a widow in the age group of 40-59 years.

source.publisher: Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India (NSAP portal FAQ)
source.locator: NSAP portal FAQ; Q17 answer, sentence 1

passages.scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme
passages.text: The applicant should belong to a household living below the poverty line.

source.publisher: Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India (NSAP portal FAQ)
source.locator: NSAP portal FAQ; Q17 answer, sentence 2

passages.scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme
passages.text:
Pension will be discontinued
In case of remarriage of widow
Once the widow moves above poverty line

source.publisher: Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India (NSAP portal FAQ)

passages.scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme
passages.text:
Death Certificate of husband – With the name of the surviving wife(widow).
BPL Card.
Age Proof - For age, the birth certificate or school certificate may be relied on. In their absence ration card and EPIC may be considered. If there is no valid document, any Medical Officer of any government hospital may be authorized to issue the age certificate.
